channel.title: Ukiyoe Edo Life
channel.desc: Edo was a city of waterways. The Yoroi Ferry transported people across the Nihonbashi River, one of its main commercial arteries. For the captain, it was a high-pressure job requiring skill and guts.\n\n*\"The Yoroi Ferry\" from the series \"Fine Views of Edo\" (1835-39) by Utagawa Hiroshige.
